legend.identity: The pack reference changed: name, layer, type, tag, version, packUid or registryUid. The release points at a different pack build.
legend.upstream: The digest on the pack reference changed: pack content moved under the hood, possibly under the same version. Which field fed it is hash.upstreamSource in the snapshot.
legend.authored: Profile-level configuration changed: the pack's values YAML (compared canonically, so formatting does not count), its attached manifests, or its params.
legend.images: The image list that the values declare changed, pack.content.images: an image added, removed, or at another tag. A detail of AUTHORED. The list holds a tag and not a digest, so an image rebuilt under one tag does not show.
legend.charts: The chart list that the values declare changed, pack.content.charts: a chart added, removed, or at another version. A detail of AUTHORED.

impact.cluster-wide: CNI or CSI layer changed; affects every node and may repave.
impact.in-place: Add-on pack upgraded or reconfigured in place.
impact.may-repave: Node or control plane configuration changed on the OS or Kubernetes layer; Palette may repave.
impact.none: No change, only the tag name of a pack changed for the same build, an OS, Kubernetes, or kernel pack moved to another pack reference at the same version, or only the version of a pack changed and it kept its numbers: renumber only.
impact.repave: Nodes are replaced on a cluster of the kubeadm engine: OS image or Kubernetes version change. compare --repave asks Palette.
impact.sync: Only the upstream digest changed, or an OS, Kubernetes, or kernel pack moved to another pack reference at the same version and its digest changed. Applied on the next profile sync.

status.changed: Node hash differs; see identity, upstream and authored.
status.unchanged: Same node hash on both sides.

op.added: The leaf exists only in B.
op.changed: The leaf exists on both sides with different values.
op.removed: The leaf exists only in A.
